race.description: Become A Southside Racing Member Mdn Plate
race.comment: SOMETHINGS BURNIN' (11) resumes. He ran third in a feature maiden on debut at Newcastle with stakes form out of that race before tackling a G3 Baillieu himself next time out and finishing down the track. He should be an improver this time around and has jumped out well leading in. IN'KANTOSSTAR (3) resumes having just found one better on debut at Moe back in December. Off the long break and drawn very wide here but is a well-related type who can take holding out. KOKO (6) is struggling to break through but ran well last time here over 1000m when getting into second. Tough draw but will roll forward and give a sight. SEALAND (7) was okay fresh at Pakenham Synthetic and should be fitter onto turf here. YELLOWKNIFE (16) held ground on debut at Seymour and was in the market. Look for improvement.
